messages:
Sam: Heads-up: nightly perf dashboard flagged p95 spike on canary region around 02:05 UTC. Link: https://dash.internal/r/abcd :eyes:
Neha: Which metric? p50/p95/p99?
Sam: p95 for short-seq requests (<=128) up ~40% vs baseline, throughput steady.
Eli: Any correlating deploys? release-2026.03.17 merged last night.
Sam: Yes — merge b3f4ad bumped kernel-selector heuristics and batching-window defaults (PR #4123).
PerfBot: CI perf job linux-gpu-2 failed: p95 +30% — https://ci.internal/build/9876 :warning:
Neha: Can we reproduce in staging? Run: `make perf-run PROFILE=nightly` and upload traces.
Eli: I ran a quick trace on canary. Flamegraph shows kernel_select() CPU spike; poly_kern() hot at the same time.
Sam: KV cache miss rate also jumped (4% -> 12%) around the spike timestamp.
Neha: That smells like batching alignment changing hotset churn -> cache thrash.
Eli: Starting a git bisect across recent merges (range: b3f4ad..HEAD) now.
Sam: I prepared a revert candidate PR: #4131 (revert kernel-selector heuristic tweak) if bisect pins it.
Neha: Before revert, collect targeted runs with env: `KERN_DEBUG=1 LOG_BATCH=true` and capture KV histograms.
Sam: Uploaded flamegraph + perf summary: https://artifacts.internal/fg/1729456789.svg and https://artifacts/internal/perf/1729456789.txt
PerfBot: Alert annotated with run ids: run-9876, run-9877, and CI job 3214.
Eli: If bisect points to selector, we'll hold canary and roll back; coordinate with releases team.
Sam: Pinging @Oncall and @release-lead to pause rollout and freeze canaries.
Oncall: Acknowledged — canary hold applied, informing release lead and SRE. :white_check_mark:
Neha: TL;DR: p95 spike tied to kernel-selector heuristic + batching-window tweak -> amplified KV misses. Bisect in flight, revert queued if confirmed.
Eli: Next steps: finish bisect, run targeted canary with revert patch, surface KV histograms and flamegraphs to postmortem.
Sam: I'll update this thread with bisect result in ~30m.
